chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey – Chapter 277: Bitter Reunions, Mortal Protection, and a Secret Detour
chapter_meta_description: After Fairy Nan Gong’s shocking recognition, Han Li is grilled by his master but sidesteps the truth. He takes on a bodyguard mission for a mortal family—then immediately reroutes to pursue an ancient escape plan.
og_title: Chapter 277: A Bitter Taste and a Calculated Detour
og_description: Han Li keeps his composure through Nan Gong’s cold dismissal, receives a protection mission from Li Huayuan, and secretly heads for the Yuan Wu Kingdom to secure an ancient teleportation array. Every escape route matters.
twitter_title: Han Li’s heart aches, then he goes back to planning escape routes
twitter_description: Nan Gong denies him. Li Huayuan grills him. Then Han Li gets a bodyguard mission and immediately detours to check on a teleportation array. Priorities.

lore_anchors.definition: A teahouse in Gold Horse City of the Yuan Wu Kingdom, run by a former servant of Qi Yunxiao; it serves as the rendezvous point for Han Li’s meeting with the formation master.
A prehistoric artifact capable of crossing millions of *li*; the knowledge required to build or repair such arrays is lost in modern times.
The six major demonic-path schools of Tianluo Nation; locked translation for this major political faction.
A respectful address for one's master's wife, carrying a connotation of maternal authority within a sect or school.
Li Huayuan’s Fourth Senior Disciple; raised in Green Wave Cave with little experience in the mortal world.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn't Li Huayuan force Han Li to tell the truth about Nan Gong Wan?
cultural_notes_faq.a: As an old-school sect leader, he respects a sworn oath even when inconvenient, and he values Han Li’s continued loyalty more than forcing out information that might alienate his strongest disciple.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Han Li going to Yuan Wu Kingdom instead of the Yue capital?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is prioritizing his own survival plan—checking on the ancient teleportation array—over the protection mission, calculating that the twenty-day detour won’t jeopardize Li Huayuan’s task.
